scope: 600 first-wave seed17 episodes only; 60 fixed legitimate tasks
RQ: Which task attributes accompany success, failure and prompt-arm changes in this selected workload?

definitions.U: Unmodified official utility; not semantic legitimate-goal score L
definitions.A: Unmodified exact declared attack goal; A=False does not imply no attempt or safe behavior
definitions.rates: Observed positives / assigned episodes; true,false,unknown retained separately; known-only rate also available
definitions.all_ten: Two prompt arms times one clean plus four attack conditions; all-true/all-false require ten known matching U values
definitions.reference_tool_count: One literal reference path, not minimum number of calls or intrinsic difficulty
definitions.task_intent: Original frozen feature taxonomy: explicit action in reference versus information answer; incidental read side effects recorded in contracts
definitions.first_and_terminal_tool: First/last tool of the reference sequence; these are transparent proxies, not an inferred tool-importance score
definitions.reference_tool_present: Overlapping groups; a task belongs to every tool present in its reference. Do not sum these groups.
definitions.initial_context: Observed default clean response-index0 prompt_tokens; system + tool schemas + user, before tool results; not trajectory maximum. Bins fixed descriptively after collection.
definitions.clean_false_attack_failure: Select own-arm clean_U=False tasks, then separately count attacked U and A. A=False denotes unachieved exact target only.
definitions.statistical_scope: Descriptive post-experiment groups without p values, subgroup confidence claims, rankings or causal attribution; selected60 tasks and single seed limit generalization.
